name: Naturlehrpfad Alpbachtaler Seenland
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The interactive nature trail takes you through the unique lake and bog landscape of the **Alpbachtal** valley in a fun and engaging way. At 15 stations, both adults and children learn fascinating facts about animals, plants, and nature conservation. With a puzzle booklet and research tasks, the round trip turns into an exciting adventure for the whole family.
